race.comment: SAINT KARAMARA (5) produced a good effort when beaten 4.4 metres last week, her third runner-up result from her last four attempts at this circuit and distance. Looks close to a win and gets her chance coming back in grade. SYLVIA KAY NZ (3) has been excellent of late and made it two wins in a row at this venue when successful over this distance at her latest appearance, getting home by 1.7 metres. Likely to get the favours from this nice draw so could land the hat trick. NITRO DANNY (4) had a back row draw last start but came from a similar barrier to place at Penrith prior and owns a good record here. BRING YOUR BEST (7) draws wide but hasn't been too far away of late so is worth some thought.
